headline: Comoros reaches US$9.6 million staff-level agreement with IMF
summary: Comoros has reached a staff-level agreement with the IMF for US$9.56 million. The deal includes a commitment to raise fuel prices, pending final board approval.
why: IMF agreements often provide essential liquidity to developing nations in exchange for structural economic reforms, such as subsidy removals.

impacts.name: Comoros
impacts.why: IMF funding provides fiscal support and signals economic reform progress.
